moments.title: Commonwealth Games Aftermath
moments.blurb: The Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games concluded on August 2nd, with the aftermath seeing reports of missing athletes and a review of GB Snowsport funding by UK Sport.

angles.name: Missing Athletes Angle
angles.copy: The dust is settling on Glasgow 2026, but the headlines aren't all about medals. Police Scotland are investigating reports of several athletes who didn't leave the UK with their teams after the Games. Big story unfolding.

angles.name: Funding Review Angle
angles.copy: UK Sport has pulled funding from GB Snowsport for the next Olympic cycle, despite Team GB's record Winter Olympics success. The decision comes after the Commonwealth Games and a governance review.

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean UK Chart Record
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' has made UK chart history, becoming the longest-running UK number-one single of all time with 19 non-consecutive weeks at the top, surpassing Frankie Laine.

angles.name: Chart History Angle
angles.copy: History made! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is officially the longest-running UK Number One single EVER, hitting 19 non-consecutive weeks. A new chart legend is born!

angles.name: Song of the Summer Angle
angles.copy: Nineteen weeks at Number One? Sam Fender and Olivia Dean really owned the airwaves this year. Is 'Rein Me In' your ultimate track of the summer?

moments.title: Shakira & Burna Boy World Cup Anthem
moments.blurb: Shakira and Burna Boy's 'Dai Dai', the official anthem for the 2026 FIFA World Cup, peaked at number 2 on the UK Singles Chart after their performance at the final.

angles.name: World Cup Anthem Buzz
angles.copy: Still buzzing from the World Cup final performance! Shakira & Burna Boy's 'Dai Dai' hit number 2 on the UK chart, becoming the highest-charting official World Cup song ever. What a banger!

angles.name: Shakira's Chart Comeback
angles.copy: Shakira's back in the UK Top 10 for the first time in 17 years! Her World Cup anthem with Burna Boy, 'Dai Dai', is a massive hit. Who else thinks she still rules?

moments.title: The Roots Picnic Lands in London
moments.blurb: The iconic US hip hop festival, The Roots Picnic, makes its international debut at Crystal Palace Bowl in London this weekend, August 8-9, featuring The Roots, Nas, Yasiin Bey, Common, and Musiq Soulchild.

angles.name: Festival Weekend Buzz
angles.copy: London! This weekend, The Roots Picnic makes its international debut at Crystal Palace Bowl with The Roots, Nas, Yasiin Bey, and Common. Get ready for some serious hip hop vibes!

angles.name: Hip Hop Royalty
angles.copy: Bringing the best of hip hop to the UK! The Roots, Nas, Yasiin Bey are all hitting Crystal Palace Bowl this weekend for The Roots Picnic. Who are you most excited to see?

moments.title: Ariana Grande's O2 Residency
moments.blurb: Ariana Grande begins her highly anticipated ten-night 'Eternal Sunshine Tour' residency at The O2 Arena in London on August 15th, her only UK dates this year.

angles.name: Ariana Takes Over O2
angles.copy: Get ready, Arianators! Ariana Grande kicks off her massive ten-night 'Eternal Sunshine' residency at London's O2 Arena on August 15th. It's the only place to catch her in the UK!

angles.name: Pop Event of the Summer
angles.copy: Ten nights of Ariana Grande at The O2? Demand was insane! This is undoubtedly the pop event of the summer. Who's got tickets to see her live?

moments.title: The Weeknd Returns to Wembley
moments.blurb: The Weeknd brings his record-breaking 'After Hours Til Dawn Stadium Tour' back to Wembley Stadium for five nights starting August 14th.

angles.name: Wembley Stadium Takeover
angles.copy: After a sold-out run, The Weeknd is back to dominate Wembley Stadium for five nights starting August 14th! Get ready for the 'After Hours Til Dawn' experience.

angles.name: R&B Stadium King
angles.copy: Officially the biggest R&B stadium tour in music history – The Weeknd is bringing his epic show back to London. Who's excited to hear tracks from 'After Hours' and 'Dawn FM' live?

moments.title: New Album Releases: August 7th
moments.blurb: This Friday, August 7th, sees new album releases from artists including FLO ('Therapy at the Club'), Overmono ('Pure Devotion'), and Ravyn Lenae ('Blue Island').

angles.name: New Music Friday Alert
angles.copy: New Music Friday is almost here! This August 7th, get ready for fresh albums from FLO, Overmono, and Ravyn Lenae. What's going straight into your weekend playlist?

angles.name: Album Drop Anticipation
angles.copy: Counting down to Friday's album drops! FLO's 'Therapy at the Club', Overmono's 'Pure Devotion' – which new release are you most hyped for?

moments.title: Ian Anderson's 79th Birthday
moments.blurb: Ian Anderson, legendary frontman and flautist of Jethro Tull, turns 79 on August 10th.

angles.name: Jethro Tull Legend
angles.copy: Happy 79th Birthday to the iconic Ian Anderson of Jethro Tull on August 10th! What's your favourite Jethro Tull track showcasing his incredible flute work?

angles.name: Prog Rock Pioneer
angles.copy: A true pioneer of progressive rock, Ian Anderson celebrates his 79th birthday next Monday. His influence on music is undeniable. Any Jethro Tull fans out there?

moments.title: Neneh Cherry's 62nd Birthday
moments.blurb: Influential Swedish singer-songwriter Neneh Cherry, known for hits like 'Buffalo Stance' and 'Manchild', celebrates her 62nd birthday on August 10th.

angles.name: Iconic 80s/90s Artist
angles.copy: Happy 62nd Birthday to the incredible Neneh Cherry on August 10th! From 'Buffalo Stance' to 'Manchild', her unique style and sound defined an era. What's your favourite Neneh Cherry track?

angles.name: Still Sounding Fresh
angles.copy: Neneh Cherry's music still sounds as fresh and relevant today as it did decades ago. Wishing a very happy 62nd to a true original!
